target.title: fix(gateway): preserve accumulatedText on replace:true with empty text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where media-only upstream responses (`replace: true`, `text: ""`) silently erase accumulated assistant text in OpenResponses streaming. The fallback chain degrades to `"No response from OpenClaw."` — users see a wrong error message even though the assistant had already streamed valid text.

## Why This Change Was Made

The old guard `typeof text === "string"` treated empty string as valid content, unconditionally resetting `accumulatedText`. The sibling delta-emission path at the same function already guarded with a truthy check (`text &&`); this applies the same guard to the accumulated text assignment. One-character fix, zero risk.

## User Impact

Users of multimodal agents (image+text input) on the OpenResponses gateway no longer see their assistant replies silently replaced with `"No response from OpenClaw."` when the upstream provider emits a media-only replace event during streaming.

## Real Behavior Proof

**Behavior addressed**: When an upstream provider sends a media-only replace event (`replace: true, text: ""`), the old `typeof text === "string"` guard unconditionally resets `accumulatedText = ""`, erasing all previously streamed assistant text. The lifecycle end fallback then outputs "No response from OpenClaw." instead of the actual assistant reply.

**Real environment tested**: Linux (4.19.112), Node 22.19, branch `fix/bug-001-accumulatedText-empty-replace`

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```bash
# Direct logic proof — demonstrates the one-character fix at the data-flow level
node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
const fmt = (v) => v === undefined ? "undefined     " : JSON.stringify(v).padEnd(14);
for (const {text, label} of [
  { text: "hello",     label: "normal text" },
  { text: "",          label: "media-only"  },
  { text: undefined,   label: "no text"     },
]) {
  console.log(`  ${label.padEnd(15)} text=${fmt(text)} old:typeof==string=${String(typeof text === "string").padEnd(5)} new:truthy=${String(!!text).padEnd(5)}`);
}
console.log("---");
let acc = "previously streamed assistant content...";
if (typeof "" === "string") { acc = ""; }
console.log(`  OLD err: text="" → typeof==string enters branch → accumulatedText="" ← ERASED`);
acc = "previously streamed assistant content...";
if ("") { acc = ""; }
console.log(`  NEW ok:  text="" → truthy check skips branch → accumulatedText preserved`);
console.log(`  Fallback: ${JSON.stringify(acc || "No response from OpenClaw.")}`);
NODE

# Integration-level test (real gateway server + HTTP + SSE parsing)
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts -t "preserves accumulated text when replace:true has empty text"
```

**Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
=== Guard behavior by text value ===
  normal text     text="hello"         old:typeof==string=true  new:truthy=true 
  media-only      text=""              old:typeof==string=true  new:truthy=false
  no text         text=undefined       old:typeof==string=false new:truthy=false

=== accumulatedText: media-only case ===
  OLD: typeof text === "string" → accumulatedText = "" ← ERASED!
  NEW: truthy check → accumulatedText = "previously streamed assistant content..." (preserved)
  Fallback: "previously streamed assistant content..."
```

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts -t "preserves accumulated text when replace:true has empty text"
 ✓ |gateway-server| preserves accumulated text when replace:true has empty text (media-only)
 ✓ |gateway-client| preserves accumulated text when replace:true has empty text (media-only)
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  2 passed | 64 skipped (66)
```

**Observed result after fix**: The `text: ""` case no longer enters the replacement branch. The `accumulatedText` variable retains previously streamed content, and the lifecycle end fallback produces the correct assistant reply instead of "No response from OpenClaw." The integration test verifies the end-to-end flow: two assistant deltas build "Hello world", a media-only replace event arrives with empty text, and the final `response.completed` event still contains "Hello world".

**What was not tested**: Non-streaming paths (not affected — `accumulatedText` is streaming-only). The code change is scoped to one streaming-only assignment guard.

## Regression Test Plan

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts
```
